BRANDING / 02 OF 07

accelScale

Built around forward motion.

A sharp, considered identity that turns acceleration and growth into a clear visual language.

THE PROJECT

The idea behind the identity.

The accelScale identity takes its cue from the name: acceleration and scale. Angular forms suggest forward movement, while a restrained colour palette keeps the overall expression precise and professional.

DESIGN DIRECTION

A small detail. A clear direction.

The “A” becomes an upward-pointing form, giving the wordmark a sense of progress. Sharp edges and clean letterforms reinforce the same idea, creating an identity that feels focused and consistent.

THE VISUAL LANGUAGE

Colour sets the tone.

Cobalt#2B308C
Charcoal#313233
Periwinkle#6B6FAF
TYPOGRAPHY

Mallory

Used for headings to give the identity a clear, structured voice.

TYPOGRAPHY

Montserrat

A clean companion for supporting information and body copy.

IN APPLICATION

One system, across every touchpoint.

The angular motif extends beyond the logo into business cards, letterheads and stationery, bringing the same sense of direction to each application.
